article.title: U.S. bombs a wedding in Iran

article.content: The generals can change deployments, move ships and planes, and order another round of bombing. None of that solves Washington’s basic problem: the Iranian people have not surrendered. The post U.S. bombs a wedding in Iran appeared first on MR Online .
